- `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci __tests__/w03ImportAdmissionAttack.test.ts __tests__/w03ImportAdmissionOriginalPathAttack.test.ts` → exit 1; Test Suites 2 failed/2; Tests 14 failed, 98 passed, 112 total, 0 skipped (attack-head.log).

ATTACKS TRIED (12 classes/attacks): (1) boundary values on media envelope — NaN/±Infinity/negative/zero duration+fps, inclusive limits, 4096-px and pixel-cap edges, rotation ∈{0,90,180,270} vs 45/-90/360/NaN, codec case/syntax (uppercase, 9-char, non-alnum), track counts NaN/-1/0/1.5/2/∞ → all refused precisely, no throw (held; note: `avc3` is refused although the implementer summary lists it as supported — documented, not counted as break). (2) comparable-event monotonicity / rally reduction → BREAK P1. (3) pose coverage vs wrist evidence → BREAK P2. (4) timeline/coverage boundaries — untracked span exactly 2500 ms vs 2501, sidecar overrun exactly 50 ms vs 51, negative first timestamp, frameCount ±1, duplicate/rewinding timestamps, non-finite landmark coords, exactly 12 vs 11 frames, empty sequence/empty landmarks → all held, no NaN/Infinity speeds, no throws. (5) player copy for all 20 reasons — dossier-forbidden terms, accuracy %, superlatives, template leaks, distinctness → held. (6) rotation/codec/track probe reachability from runCaptureAnalysis → BREAK P2 (dead code). (7) saved-original path refused import leaves no attempt → BREAK P1. (8) process death + startup recovery → BREAK (reserve called). (9) explicit Check/reconcile + 429 Retry-After + 5xx at reserve → BREAK (server permit reserved+finalized; rows held on network) — conservation sub-assertion (no charge, no 'scored' finalize, analyzeCapture never called) HELD. (10) retry after refusal keeps precise reason → BREAK (generic recovery_pending copy). (11) concurrent double submit of a refused import → held (no permit traffic, no duplicate attempt). (12) account switch after refusal → held (other account's recovery sees nothing, cannot reserve).

Not applicable / not attempted: unauthorised-role SQL/Edge (package adds no SQL/Edge surface); clock rollback (gate is clock-free).
